'''Zeka grass''' was a type of spotted [[Grass/Legends|grass]] that grew on the plains of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. It was eaten by [[suubatar]]s.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
